answer: A cart that shudders on a flat road tells you the wheel was never trued. Proof of wheelwright cart via spoke fit tally — a wheel the wright trues only after 24 spokes run true, each spoke fitted by the wright himself. The tide turns the hub round while the spokes are fitted. The gale shapes each spoke to the same length. The falcon greases the axle before the cart rolls out. Forging the wheel takes 24 spokes fitted true, 24 spokes wedged and 24 spokes counted, two days at the bench for a wheel that still wobbles.
